svg.title: Azure landing zone: platform landing zone and workload landing zones
svg.desc: Layout follows the detailed conceptual architecture diagram on Microsoft Learn. Inside one Azure landing zone frame, the platform landing zone panel is on top. It is managed by the platform team and has a management group band with the Platform group (Security, Management, Identity and Connectivity) and the Landing zones group (Corp, Online and Local), with Azure Policy applied. Platform subscriptions hold centralized resources; Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra Domain Services, virtual networks and Log Analytics workspaces are examples. A box says that workload landing zone subscriptions are distributed and placed under the right management group. An arrow leads down to the workload landing zones panel, managed by workload teams, which shows example Internal (Corp), Online and Local workloads. Each workload landing zone has environments for production, test and development, each in one or more subscriptions. The platform landing zone is one per Microsoft Entra tenant. Icons are official Azure icons.
svg.text: The platform team manages the platform landing zone.
Examples: Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra Domain Services,
Distribution and placement of workload landing zone
subscriptions under the right management group
Platform landing zone: most organizations need one per Microsoft Entra tenant. It provides centralized governance and shared resources.
Workload teams manage the workload landing zones.
Each workload has one workload landing zone made of all its environments.
Each environment is one or more Azure subscriptions.
